enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up to chin. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back. Snore. Turn on back. Stretch arms. Turn to left side. Pull blanket over head. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up, brushing teeth, and getting dressed for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Apply soap. Rub hands together. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe mouth with towel. Remove pajamas. Put on underwear. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating a relaxed holiday breakfast
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and milk. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Take out bowl and pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into bowl. Add milk. Whisk. Pour into pan. Cook. Stir. Turn off stove. Slide eggs onto plate. Sit at table. Eat eggs. Drink milk. Place plate in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Tidying up the living room and vacuuming the floor
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Pick up cushions. Place cushions on couch. Pick up magazines. Stack magazines on coffee table. Pick up trash. Throw trash in bin. Open closet. Take out vacuum cleaner. Plug in vacuum. Turn on vacuum. Push vacuum across floor. Pull vacuum back. Vacuum under couch. Turn off vacuum. Unplug vacuum. Open closet. Put vacuum away. Close closet. Sit on couch.

enriched_activities.activity: Grocery shopping at the local market for the week
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of house. Walk to market. Enter market. Pick up basket. Pick up apples. Place in basket. Pick up bananas. Place in basket. Pick up milk. Place in basket. Pick up cheese. Place in basket. Pick up chicken. Place in basket. Walk to checkout. Place basket on counter. Pay cashier. Receive receipt. Pick up bags. Walk home. Enter house.

enriched_activities.activity: Putting away groceries and wiping down the kitchen counters
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Place grocery bags on counter. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and cheese. Place in refrigerator. Take out chicken. Place in refrigerator. Take out apples and bananas. Place in fruit bowl. Close refrigerator. Pick up sponge. Wet sponge. Wipe counter. Rinse sponge. Dry counter. Throw away packaging. Wash hands.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and relaxing on the couch
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Press power button. TV screen lights up. Browse channels. Stop on program. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Lean back. Put feet on coffee table. Watch TV. Laugh. Change channel. Watch more TV. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating a light lunch
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out bread, ham, lettuce, mayonnaise. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Take out plate and knife. Place bread on cutting board. Spread mayonnaise. Add ham. Add lettuce. Top with bread. Cut sandwich. Place on plate. Sit at table. Eat sandwich. Drink water. Stand up. Carry plate to sink. Rinse plate.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading a book and resting quietly
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Lie on bed. Pick up book. Open book. Read. Turn page. Read. Adjust pillow. Turn page. Read. Close book. Place book on nightstand. Close eyes. Rest. Turn to side. Pull blanket. Breathe slowly. Open eyes. Sit up. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a leisurely walk in the nearby park
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of house. Walk to park. Enter park. Walk along path. Look at trees. Walk past bench. Continue walking. Stop at pond. Watch ducks. Walk around pond. Sit on bench. Stand up. Walk back. Exit park. Walk home. Enter house.

enriched_activities.activity: Boiling the kettle and having an afternoon tea and snack
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Fill kettle with water. Place kettle on base. Turn on kettle. Open cupboard. Take out mug and tea bag. Place tea bag in mug. Pour boiled water into mug. Add milk. Stir with spoon. Sit at table. Drink tea. Eat snack. Finish tea. Rinse mug.

enriched_activities.activity: Planning upcoming community programs on the computer with the desk lamp on
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Press power button. Open planning document. Type notes. Add event to calendar. Save document. Open email. Read messages. Reply to email. Open spreadsheet. Update budget. Save spreadsheet. Close laptop. Turn off desk lamp. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner on the induction cooker
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and chicken. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Take out pot and knife. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Cut chicken. Place pot on induction cooker. Turn on cooker. Add oil. Add chicken. Stir. Add vegetables. Add sauce. Cover pot. Simmer. Turn off cooker. Serve onto plate.

Sit at table. Pick up fork. Pick up knife. Cut chicken. Lift fork to mouth. Chew. Swallow. Cut vegetables. Eat. Drink water. Continue eating. Finish meal. Push plate away. Stand up. Carry plate to sink. Rinse plate. Place plate in dishwasher. Wipe table. Wash hands.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and drying hair
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Remove clothes. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse body. Apply shampoo. Lather. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Hang towel. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Select streaming service. Choose show. Watch show. Adjust volume. Lean back. Put feet up. Watch. Laugh. Pause show. Resume show. Watch more. Show ends. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Browsing the phone and winding down before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Lie on bed. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open social media app. Scroll. Like post. Open messaging app. Read message. Type reply. Send. Open news app. Read article. Close app. Lock phone. Place phone on nightstand. Turn off light. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Breathe slowly.

Lie on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back. Snore. Turn on back. Stretch arms. Turn to left side. Pull blanket over head. Continue sleeping.
